name: How long does a kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel depends on its complexity. A minor cosmetic update, like painting cabinets and replacing countertops, might take 2-4 weeks. A more extensive remodel involving new layouts, custom cabinetry, and plumbing/electrical work can take 6-12 weeks, or even longer for large projects. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and the contractor's schedule can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor kitchen remodel typically takes 2-4 weeks, while extensive projects can last 6-12 weeks or more, depending on scope and materials.
